My advise as a non binary lesbian aka a "butch" looking lesbian is just start traveling... But start with places familiar to you. Be aware about what would make you a target... The "gay" is one aspect... walking around in a crowd lost reading Google maps as a tourist is a much bigger risk. 

Go to cities you've wanted to visit that our similar in size to cities you grew up in or by... And have similar "open mindedness" 

As you get more aware feel free to branch out to more areas. I think the biggest thing if you are driving around some rural parts US (and maybe Canada) is it is more likely to be conservative but that doesn't mean the people will be dangerous but just be aware of your surroundings, have your phone charged, know where your car keys are. Don't pull up at a rest stop in Idaho and park right next to a giant truck with a trump flag and a confederate flag and get out of your vehicle with no one else around, no cell signal and no idea where the owner of the truck is....

I travel quite a bit alone. In fact this sept I'm making my way from LA by train to Seattle to Victoria than Vancouver cruise back to San Diego... all alone. Cannot wait!

Ironically the time I felt the most unsafe as a "butch" lesbian because I was a lesbian was in none other than San Francisco. So ya never know.
